content.instruction: Write a job application. You are applying for a department head position in the Ministry for Foreign Affairs. Tell about your experience in international relations, diplomatic tasks, and demanding civil service work. Also describe how you have promoted Finland's foreign policy objectives and built international networks. Length about 320 words.
